Package swiss.trustbroker.saml.dto

Class RpRequest

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.saml.dto.ResponseStatus
swiss.trustbroker.saml.dto.RpRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RpRequest extends ResponseStatus
Class is used to implement the contract towards ScriptService on RP request processing side. See CpResponse class for counterpart on CP side.

      public RpRequest(String referer, String rpIssuer, String requestId, String applicationName, List<String> contextClasses, Map<String,String> context, QoaComparison comparisonType, boolean useSkinnyHrdScreen, List<ClaimsProvider> claimsProviders, UiObjects uiObjects)
      Creates a new RpRequest instance.
      Parameters:
      referer - Referer header from the incoming HTTP request.
      rpIssuer - Issuer of the incoming SAML request
      requestId - ID of the incoming message (e.g. AuthnRequest).
      applicationName - Application name e.g. from AuthnRequest.ProviderName.
      contextClasses - AuthnRequest RequestedAuthnContext.ContextClassRefs.
      context - Map to store internal processing attributes required during federation.
      comparisonType - AuthnRequest RequestedAuthnContext.comparisonType.
      useSkinnyHrdScreen - Allow to use a non-angular version of the HRD screen
      Default: false
      claimsProviders - ClaimsProvider mappings for RelyingParty.
      uiObjects - UI objects for the HRD screen.
      Since:
      1.9.0
